verdict.rationale: HumanLayer documents a GitHub integration, though it is described as creating tasks from issues and linking artifacts back (humanlayer-docs-16). The session agent can open a draft pull request from the GitHub tab or diff view (humanlayer-docs-19). Code access comes from workspace-configured repository worktrees on a host you supply that can reach the code (humanlayer-docs-26, humanlayer-docs-8, humanlayer-docs-7), not from connecting a GitHub repo directly. Missing for 10: evidence that connecting GitHub grants the agent repository code access, PR creation beyond draft PRs, detailed docs on the PR flow and permissions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
